rationale: C14 plausibly supplied a concrete partial template for the child's controls on advisory bodies. Both instruments favor full-time Government personnel for governmental operations, restrict outside advisers to advisory roles while reserving decisions to responsible Government officials, address conflicts between private interests and Government duties, and impose written documentation and reporting requirements. These linked mechanisms are materially closer than a shared general concern with uniform administration. C09 and C24 also prescribe detailed, uniform, government-wide procedures, but their overlap with the child is substantially more generic.

shared_material.child_excerpt: no committee shall be utilized for functions not solely advisory, and determinations of action to be taken ... shall be made solely by officers or employees of the Government
shared_material.parent_excerpt: appointments under this authority shall, so far as possible, be to advisory or consultative positions only ... [and advisers] shall, when policy matters are involved, be limited to advising appropriate, full-time Government officials who are responsible for making policy decisions
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively parallel separation of outside advice from governmental decisionmaking.

shared_material.child_excerpt: a full-time salaried officer or employee of the department or agency
shared_material.parent_excerpt: operations under the Act shall be carried on by full-time, salaried employees of the Government
shared_material.explanation: Shared emphasis on control by full-time salaried Government personnel.

shared_material.child_excerpt: such committees shall function at all times in consonance with the antitrust and conflict of interest laws
shared_material.parent_excerpt: take steps to avoid, to as great an extent as possible, any conflict between the Government duties and the private interests of such personnel
shared_material.explanation: Both regulate the use of private participants through conflict-of-interest safeguards.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall publish ... a list of such committees, including the names and affiliations of their members ... [and maintain] records and files
shared_material.parent_excerpt: file with the Federal Register Division for publication ... the name of the appointee ... [and] the name of the appointee's private employer or employers
shared_material.explanation: Both use disclosure and recordkeeping concerning nongovernmental participants and their affiliations as an accountability mechanism.
